description: Kenya - Potential Expansion of Existing Mini-Grids is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access", published or maintained by Rhonda Jordan Antoine; Patrick Balla; Laurencia Njagi; Sudeshna Banerjee. (World Bank Group). This dataset represents potential expansion projects for existing mini-grids; the expansion projects were identified through a least-cost geospatial analysis undertaken over the period 2017-2018. Each project (defined by the unique “ProjectNumber”) includes electricity lines, poles, and building structures. Therefore, the dataset includes a combination of several feature types. Coverage: Kenya. It has 2 files in SHP ZIP, CSV. The portal files it under Energy access. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
